heading: What are Iran’s 7 conditions for peace talks?
body: As we’ve been reporting, Iran is insisting the US meet seven conditions before peace talks can begin and the Strait of Hormuz can reopen.

heading: WATCH: UK protesters reject ban on Palestine Action, demand end to arms for Israel
body: London’s Metropolitan Police have arrested more than 100 protesters outside the US embassy where they been demonstrating against the government’s proscription of the Palestine Action group as a “terrorist” organization.

heading: US senator blasts ‘Big Oil’ for profiting off war on Iran
body: Bernie Sanders has criticised oil companies for profiting off the US-Israel war on Iran at the expense of working class families.

heading: WATCH: Trump says he’s ‘not in that much of a hurry’ about Iran
body: US President Donald Trump, who says he came to his Mar-a-Lago Halloween costume party dressed as himself, described not being in a hurry to make a decision on striking Iran.

heading: IRGC says it’s ‘identifying new targets’ for attack response
body: Brigadier-General Hossein Mohebi, spokesman for the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, says recent remarks by Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei “have opened a new chapter” for Iran in any future wars.

heading: Israeli troops raid Nablus and other towns in occupied West Bank
body: Israeli forces have stormed the old city of Nablus and took up positions in the occupied West Bank.

heading: Iran says talks with US continue but wary of ‘Trump’s intentions’
body: Iran continues to hold negotiations with Washington through Qatar and other mediators but remains deeply sceptical of Trump’s intentions, a security source has told Al Jazeera.

heading: Iran deterrence strategy extends beyond regional boundaries, official says
body: Mohammad Mokhber, an adviser to Iran’s supreme leader, says the country’s defence doctrine is rapidly evolving, with Tehran no longer limiting its response to the geographical location of a threat.

heading: WATCH: Israeli attacks on Gaza kill at least nine people
IRGC claims two tankers hit mines in Hormuz
body: Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) has said two tankers exploded after hitting a naval mine in the Strait of Hormuz, and that one of them, a supertanker, is on fire after a severe blast.

heading: ‘Diplomacy and military preparations’ ongoing simultaneously in Iran
body: Hamidreza Azizi, a senior Iran analyst with the Crisis Group, says Tehran is pursuing diplomacy while also “attempting to redefine” the military implications of another potential conflict.

heading: No ‘appetite’ in Gulf for resumption of US-Israeli war on Iran
body: For the Gulf countries, oil exports through the Strait of Hormuz are extremely important. Oil and gas are the bread and butter that fuel these economies. But we now know just how important Gulf nations and their energy supplies are to the global market.
